A nightly preview of OpenSky, built from `main`. Expect bugs: much of the game is missing.
The [README](https://github.com/jjgroenendijk/opensky#readme) shows what is done.

## What you need

- A Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 26 (Tahoe) or newer.
- Skyrim Special Edition, bought and installed (the Windows files). OpenSky includes no game files.

## Install

1. Download the `.dmg` file below and open it.
2. Drag OpenSky onto the Applications folder next to it.
3. Open OpenSky. The preview is not notarized by Apple, so macOS stops it the first time.
   Open System Settings, go to Privacy & Security, and press **Open Anyway**.
4. If OpenSky does not find Skyrim, it opens a folder window.
   Choose the folder that holds `Data/Skyrim.esm`.

Found a problem? Open an [issue](https://github.com/jjgroenendijk/opensky/issues).
OpenSky is not made by or connected to Bethesda.
